# iosxe_sccp (Data Source)

This data source can read the SCCP configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_sccp" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `ccm_groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ccm_groups))
- `ccm_servers` (Attributes List) Configure a CCM into the sccp ccm list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ccm_servers))
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `ip_precedence` (Number) Specify the IP precedence parameter value
- `local_interface` (String) Specify the local gateway related parameters values

<a id="nestedatt--ccm_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ccm_groups`

Read-Only:

- `associate_ccm` (Attributes List) Associate a CCM to this CCM group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ccm_groups--associate_ccm))
- `associate_profiles` (Attributes List) Associate a profile to this CCM group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ccm_groups--associate_profiles))
- `description` (String) The description of this ccm group
- `group_id` (Number) Set a sccp ccm group with an ID number ID

<a id="nestedatt--ccm_groups--associate_ccm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ccm_groups.associate_ccm`

Read-Only:

- `ccm_id` (Number) The CCM identifier to be associated
- `priority` (Number) Set the CCM's priority in this CCM group


<a id="nestedatt--ccm_groups--associate_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ccm_groups.associate_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `profile_id` (String) Set the profile ID to be associated with this CCM group
- `register` (String) Configure the name of this profile to be registered



<a id="nestedatt--ccm_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ccm_servers`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) CCM IP address or domain name
- `identifier` (Number) Set this CCM's identifier
- `version` (String) Set the CCM's version
